entities.name: İhsan Sabri Çağlayangil
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: İhsan Sabri Çağlayangil was a Turkish politician and diplomat who served as Acting President of Turkey in 1980, from the Justice Party. He also served as Minister of Foreign Affairs three times in the 1960s and 1970s.
